headline: ROD WAVE'S 24-TRACK ALBUM ARRIVES FRIDAY
body: @rodwave's upcoming album Don't Look Down is set for release Friday, August 28, with Spotify listing 24 tracks. A song titled "2017 (Streamer U)" caught @kaicenat's attention when the tracklist was shown on his stream. The moment adds fresh momentum to Rod Wave's next full-length rollout.
caption:
